capabilities: Set, change or remove emoji icons on notes, folders and files via right-click
Search and browse emoji by name, keyword, shortcode, category or recents
Choose where icons appear (file explorer, titles, tabs, view headers, internal links)
Use emoji, uploaded images or Obsidian's built-in icons with selectable emoji fonts
Auto-assign icons to newly created notes based on their names
disambiguation: It assigns display-only icons; it never inserts emoji into note names or note contents.
extras: Icon assignments persist across renames and moves, and deleted paths are retained to prevent data loss during sync; auto-assignment is disabled by default and supports English and German note names.
motivation: The author wants to make the vault feel a little cozier, per the README's framing.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows only plain text names, making notes and folders hard to tell apart at a glance.
summary: Emoji icon picker that assigns icons to notes and folders in the file explorer, with display in titles, tabs and links.
